policy: Same extension/name policy as publish_records.py. Only new or changed hashes versus the union of original and first-followup manifests are included. Retains failures, negative, inconclusive and source-only evidence. Excludes compiled binaries/classes, downloaded corpora, generated JS/maps, symlink targets and operational PID files. Original records are never overwritten; changed paths supplement the historical earlier archives.
normalization: Only completed ordinary experiments.py variants with a verified configured raw run count and matching median. Existing supplied fields are copied; absent RSS/ratios stay null. Diagnostic/nonstandard/incomplete summary schemas remain available in full.
